name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: Insurance aggregator wholly owned by Rasan Information Technology, a Saudi fintech that floated 30% of its shares on the Saudi Exchange's main market in 2024 (prospectus names Impact46 funds and private individuals as its 5%+ holders). Nothing found.
note: Badge on the right chest of Al-Taawoun's 2026-27 home kit (club announcement and kit-launch photos, see issue #377); also present on several other Saudi shirts (front/back).
